description: Defines the PreferencesMenu class for managing user preferences UI, including menu items, selection, and loading extension versions.

classes.name: PreferencesMenu
classes.description: Manages preferences menu state, including menu items, selected pane, and extension versions.

methods.name: menuItems
methods.description: Returns menu items with selection and bubble info.

methods.name: selectedMenuItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected menu item.

methods.name: selectedPaneId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected pane.

methods.name: selectPane
methods.description: Sets the selected pane by ID.

methods.name: sectionHasBubble
methods.description: Determines if a section has a bubble indicator, e.g., for security preferences.
